title.ja: 図1-1 雀刺しの駒組みの一例
title.en: Figure 1-1: An example of Suzume-zashi formation

explain.ja: 図1-1は雀刺しの駒組みの一例です。お互いに矢倉囲いに囲う将棋で、先手は端に飛車・角・桂・香を利かせています。このように端に駒を集中させて矢倉囲いを一気に崩しにいく指し方を雀刺しと呼びます。ここでは雀刺しの駒組みと攻め方を解説します。
explain.en: Diagram 1-1 is an example of the Sparrow Strike (suzume-zashi) setup. Both sides have Yagura castles, and Black has rook, bishop, knight and lance bearing on the edge. Concentrating pieces on the edge to break the Yagura at once is called Sparrow Strike. This section explains its setup and attack.

section.ja: 雀刺し(すずめざし)ってどんな戦法?端攻めを狙え!
section.en: What is the Sparrow Strike (Suzumezashi) strategy? Aim for the edge attack!

title.ja: 図2-1 相矢倉の基本形
title.en: Figure 2-1: Basic form of Double Yagura

explain.ja: 図2-1は相矢倉の基本形です。この形から雀刺しを狙う指し方を見ます。
explain.en: Diagram 2-1 is the basic form of Double Yagura. We look at how to aim for the Sparrow Strike from this form.

section.en: Basic form of Yagura vs Yagura

title.ja: 図2-2 お互いに矢倉囲いを完成させる
title.en: Figure 2-2: Both sides complete the Yagura castle

explain.ja: 相矢倉の基本形から、お互いに矢倉囲いを完成させました。雀刺しは端からの攻めを狙うため、相手玉が△2二玉と矢倉囲いの中まで入っているときの方が攻めが強烈になります。
explain.en: From the basic Double Yagura form, both sides completed their Yagura castles. Since the Sparrow Strike aims at an edge attack, it is stronger when the opponent's king has gone into the castle at △2二玉.

section.ja: 矢倉囲いを完成させる

line.text: ▲6八角、△4三金、▲7九玉、△4二角、▲2六歩、△3一玉、▲8八玉、△2二玉

explain.ja: 端歩を突いて攻めを狙います。ここで相手が△1四歩と突き合ってくる場合と、放置して▲1五歩と位を取らせる場合があります。それぞれの場合の雀刺しの仕掛けを見ます。
explain.en: Push the edge pawn and aim to attack. The opponent may answer with △1四歩, or ignore it and let Black take the position with ▲1五歩. We look at the Sparrow Strike attack in each case.

section.ja: 端から攻めていくのが狙い
section.en: Aim to attack from the edge

title.ja: 図3-1 お互いに端歩を突き合う
title.en: Figure 3-1: Both sides push the edge pawns

explain.ja: まず、お互いに端歩を突き合う形での攻めを見ます。
explain.en: First, the attack where both sides have pushed their edge pawns.

section.ja: お互いに端歩を突き合う

title.ja: 図3-2 香車の裏側に飛車を

explain.ja: ▲1七香から▲1八飛として、香車の裏側に飛車を回すのが雀刺しの特徴的な駒組みです。このように端に戦力を集めて1筋の強行突破を狙います。香車と飛車で2段ロケットのような形になります。
explain.en: ▲1七香 followed by ▲1八飛, placing the rook behind the lance, is the characteristic Sparrow Strike setup. Forces are gathered on the edge to break through the 1st file by force, making a two-stage rocket of lance and rook.

section.ja: 飛車、角、銀、香での端攻めを狙う
section.en: Aim for an edge attack with rook, bishop, silver and lance

line.text: ▲3七銀、△7三銀、▲2五歩、△8五歩、▲1七香、△6四銀、▲1八飛

title.ja: 図3-3 飛車、角、銀、香で端攻め
title.en: Figure 3-3: Edge attack with rook, bishop, silver and lance

explain.ja: 銀も前に進めて端攻めに参加させます。気づきにくいですが、角も遠くから1三に利いていて端を狙えます。お互いに端歩を突き合う形では、飛車・角・銀・香の4枚での端攻めを目指します。
explain.en: Advance the silver too and bring it into the edge attack. Less obviously, the bishop also covers 1三 from afar, aiming at the edge. When both sides have pushed edge pawns, aim for an edge attack with the four pieces rook, bishop, silver and lance.

section.ja: 飛車、角、銀、香での端攻めを狙う
section.en: Aim for an edge attack with rook, bishop, silver and lance

title.ja: 図3-4 銀から使うのがポイント
title.en: Figure 3-4: Using the silver first is the key

explain.ja: ▲1五歩から仕掛けます。△同歩に対してつい▲同香と取りたくなりますが、▲同銀とするのがポイントです。
explain.en: Start with ▲1五歩. After △同歩 you may be tempted to take with ▲同香, but the key is ▲同銀.

section.ja: 銀から攻めていって優勢!
section.en: Attacking with the silver first for an advantage!

title.ja: 図3-5 銀香交換の駒損だが、端を突破！
title.en: Figure 3-5: A material loss with silver-for-lance, but the edge is broken through!

explain.ja: 図3-4から△同香、▲同香と進めば、銀香交換で駒損になりますが、端を突破できます。端攻めでは銀よりも香車の方が使いやすいので、わざと銀を渡しているのがポイントです。この局面ではすでに飛車・角・香の3枚が1三に利いていて、相手に受けはありません。
explain.en: From Diagram 3-4, △同香 ▲同香 loses material in a silver-for-lance exchange but breaks through the edge. In an edge attack a lance is easier to use than a silver, so giving up the silver is deliberate. Here the rook, bishop and lance already cover 1三, and the opponent has no defense.

section.ja: 銀から攻めていって優勢!
section.en: Attacking with the silver first for an advantage!

explain.ja: 図2-3に戻り、別の指し手を見ます。今度は相手が端歩を突いてこなかったため、▲1五歩と1筋の位を取る形になりました。
explain.en: Return to Diagram 2-3 and see another line. This time the opponent did not push the edge pawn, so Black takes the 1st-file position with ▲1五歩.

section.en: When you get the edge position

title.ja: 図4-2 今度は桂馬で端を狙う
title.en: Figure 4-2: This time target the edge with the knight

explain.ja: 端の位を取れたときは、銀ではなく桂馬で端を狙うのがポイントです。この局面では、飛車・角・桂・香の4枚で1三を狙えます。2筋の歩を五段目まで突かずにおくのも細かいポイントで、この後▲2五桂と跳ねるためのスペースを空けておきます。
explain.en: When you have taken the edge position, the key is to aim at the edge with the knight rather than the silver. Here rook, bishop, knight and lance can all target 1三. A fine point is leaving the 2nd-file pawn from advancing to the fifth rank, keeping space for the knight to jump to ▲2五.

section.ja: 飛車、角、桂、香での端攻めを狙う
section.en: Aim for an edge attack with rook, bishop, knight and lance

line.text: △8五歩、▲3七桂、△6四銀、▲1七香、△9四歩、▲1八飛

title.ja: 図4-3 桂跳ねから仕掛ける
title.en: Figure 4-3: Attack starting with the knight jump

explain.ja: 桂跳ねから仕掛けます。一見銀取りが狙いに見えますが、狙いは端を攻め潰すことです。
explain.en: Start the attack with the knight jump. It looks as if the aim is to attack the silver, but the actual aim is to crush the edge.

section.en: All-out attack after a knight sacrifice

title.ja: 図4-4 いきなり桂馬を成り捨てる
title.en: Figure 4-4: Suddenly sacrifice the knight by promoting

explain.ja: いきなり▲1三桂成と桂馬を成り捨てるのがポイントです。駒損の攻めですが、端を突破すればすぐ取り返せます。
explain.en: The key is sacrificing the knight at once with ▲1三桂成. It loses material, but breaking through the edge regains it quickly.

section.en: All-out attack after a knight sacrifice

title.ja: 図4-5 ガジガジ攻めていく
title.en: Figure 4-5: Keep gnawing at the attack

explain.ja: 桂馬はただで取られましたが、▲1四歩と追撃すれば問題ありません。
explain.en: The knight is lost for free, but following up with ▲1四歩 is fine.

section.ja: 銀を取りながらガジガジ攻めていく
section.en: Attack relentlessly while capturing the silver

title.ja: 図4-6 雀刺しが攻めやすい展開に
title.en: Figure 4-6: Suzume-zashi gets an easy attack

explain.ja: 端をがりがり攻めて、先手が指しやすい展開になります。相手にはまだ粘る順もありますが、雀刺しは勝ちやすい将棋と言えます。相手には△同香のほか、△1三歩や△1二歩といった受けもあります。
explain.en: Pressing the edge relentlessly gives Black an easy game. The opponent still has ways to resist, but Sparrow Strike is a strategy that wins easily. Besides △同香, the opponent also has defenses such as △1三歩 or △1二歩.

section.ja: 銀を取りながらガジガジ攻めていく
section.en: Attack relentlessly while capturing the silver

title.ja: 図a-1 銀を端から逸らす
title.en: Figure a-1: Deflect the silver from the edge

explain.ja: ▲1四歩と突いた局面で、△同銀でなく△2四銀と逃げてきた場合は、▲2五歩が厳しい手です。△同銀なら▲1三歩成で端を潰せます。
explain.en: In the position after ▲1四歩, if White escapes with △2四銀 instead of △同銀, ▲2五歩 is severe. If △同銀, ▲1三歩成 crushes the edge.

section.ja: 銀を取りながらガジガジ攻めていく
section.en: Attack relentlessly while capturing the silver
